title: xanthium canadense var. palustre
intro: Xanthium canadense var. palustre, commonly known as marsh cocklebur, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asian cultures. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of marsh cocklebur include its ability to induce sweating, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
